about_the_game:
Hepatomancy is a FPS roguelike. Delve deep in an ever shifting temple complex. Learn the esoteric secrets of the ruins and their inhabitants, and do your best to reach the inner-most chamber.

RANDOMLY GENERATED FLOORS

Familiar, yet always different, the only sure way is down. Navigate the connected rooms of the cursed temple, stumble through generated levels, discover new areas and reveal ancient secrets.

A STRANGE PATH

While the way down is very obvious, it is perhaps not the only one, or even the best one. The temple is full of secrets, and some artifacts might just lead you somewhere new.

Features

  • procedurally generated levels

  • first person action roguelike

  • impactful items

This demo allows you to explore the first few levels of the temple complex.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5 3rd gen or similar
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulcan compatible GC with 500MB of VRAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5 5th gen or similar
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce™ GTX 1060
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
